cohort: The study included paired maternal and singleton infant cord samples from 54 pregnancies with low birthweight infants and 110 pregnancies with normal birthweight infants.
finding: After adjustment for covariates, there was no significant difference in cord-maternal RSV anti-preF IgG ratios between low birthweight and normal birthweight infants.
birth_weight: Low birthweight (<2500 g, median 1902 g [1393-2276 g]) and Normal birthweight (median 3323 g [3109-3565 g]) infants.
gest_age: Low birthweight infants (median 34.0 weeks [31.7-37.1 weeks]) and Normal birthweight infants (median 39.1 weeks [38.3-39.9 weeks]), including preterm and full-term infants.
